entries.title: 2 John 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 He exhorts a certain honourable matron, with her children, to persevere in Christian love and belief, 8 lest they lose the reward of their former profession; 10 and to have nothing to do with those seducers that bring not the true doctrine of Christ Jesus.
